trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then activities, then clean-up.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Clear activities, collectibles and challenges last.

trophies.guide: Story trophy from the opening mission Gone Fishing. It unlocks automatically as you play the intro.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Follow the on-screen objectives to the end.

trophies.guide: Chapter trophy. Keep playing the story and it unlocks when Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Watch for the trophy at the chapter close.

trophies.guide: Chapter trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Pure story progress, nothing to grind.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: It pops at the chapter close.

trophies.guide: Chapter trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Just keep the story moving.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: It pops at the chapter close.

trophies.guide: Chapter trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Story progress only.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: It pops at the chapter close.

trophies.guide: Gold for beating the game. Finish the final mission and the credits roll with this trophy.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete it to finish the story.

trophies.guide: Mission trophy for Breakfast Run. Unmissable if you play the story.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Start Breakfast Run from the story.

trophies.guide: Mission trophy for The Cartel Heist. Follow the heist plan and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Mission trophy for Child's Play. Story progress, no special requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Mission trophy for Headliners. Play it through to the end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Mission trophy for the VCIA Takedown. A story set-piece, not a grind.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Mission trophy for Operation Savage Glory. Finish the operation.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Gold for 100% completion: every mission, activity, collectible and challenge. The long road — save this for last and use the checklist to track what remains.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Clear every activity, collectible and challenge.

trophies.guide: Silver for 250 stunts. Stunts count across the whole game, so this builds up naturally; chase the rest near ramps and jumps.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Farm the last ones at jump spots.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once. A sampler trophy — dip into each activity and move on.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try each of the 9 types once.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver for gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Take your time, learn each range's targets, and use the best weapon for the distance.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's line, then race clean.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Win one drone race at each.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Variety counts — repeat wins on the same race do not.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Watch his timing, then out-fish him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Pick the shortest cabinet and play it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand. His final mission pops this trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver for 8 stranger strands across Leonida. Strangers appear on the map — talk to everyone with a marker.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy: meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Do it as you explore each region — there is no clean-up pass for spots you walk past and never return to.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Meditate at every spot you find, in every region.
Check the map: 18 spots total, none after the story ends.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track it, take the shot cleanly, and bring it back.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Track and hunt the unique animal.

trophies.guide: Silver for 3 complete collectible card sets. Cards hide across Leonida — collect a full set three times.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Silver for WAiNK It at 100 locations. A long tail — tag a few spots in every session and it adds up.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: WAiNK It wherever you see a spot.

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges span combat, driving and exploration — just play wide.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Break line of sight and stay out of the search zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner.
Break line of sight and escape.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops and move fast between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Rob them back-to-back, wanted level intact.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive everything you see — each new model counts once.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. Group enemies first, then trigger it when they cluster.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Trigger Combat Focus and down all 5.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA without a schedule. Find a runway, grab a plane, and take off.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos (tanks). Bring heavy weapons and keep moving — a Rhino's cannon is slow to aim.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store unseen. Go quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Silver for 5 bank vaults robbed with a clean escape each time. Plan the getaway before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit it, grab the cash, and break away fast.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — use the map tab to spot gaps.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. Mark each gang off as you clear theirs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Sit, order, enjoy the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Order a cocktail with the view.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in style. Drive straight through the glass and keep going.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Smash your way out in a vehicle.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley. Play a full game and follow through.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates alley.

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. It comes from playing the story with your partner.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play story missions with your partner.
It pops from the partnership moment.

trophies.guide: Choices made — PSN tracks a count to 500. Make choices across the game and the count climbs.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices in missions and activities.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail once at something, then nail it the next time.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Strange events hide around Leonida — keep your eyes open.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Drive by slow, swing, connect.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Melee drive-by to knock them down.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Run bills through contacts until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops. Weapons, clothes, cars — it all counts.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Save up, then buy them one by one.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the app, register.
trophies.name: On the Spot
